notes.title: Steam Scream Sale | Amnesia: The Bunker Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween everyone! 🎃

Amnesia: Rebirth and the entire Frictional Games library is part of the Steam Scream sale event with discounts up to 80%.

Amnesia: Rebirth is a first-person horror adventure. Uncover your past and survive the Algerian desert. Fear is your enemy; stay calm to not succumb to an illness threatening you and your loved one. Avoid darkness, hide from monsters and solve puzzles

If you've yet to complete the collection, now is the perfect time to ⏰

We also just launched the anticipated Halloween Update for Amnesia: The Bunker and is currently at 25% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1944430/Amnesia_The_Bunker/

This update brings a bunch of new features, adding new horrors and heaps of replay value.

If you've beaten the game once you can challenge yourself with the new Shell Shock mode - or play around with the settings in Custom Mode.

Watch the trailer now: [previewyoutube=wZgfz3bKEEE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Amnesia Re-Collection update
notes.notes:
We’ve decided to include Amnesia: The Bunker as part of the Amnesia Re-Collection and Frictional Collection bundles here on Steam, alongside SOMA, Amnesia: Rebirth and Amnesia: The Dark Descent

As an owner of one or multiple games in the Amnesia Re-Collection and Frictional Collection bundles you can now purchase the other ones (including the newly released Amnesia: The Bunker) at a discounted price!

The Amnesia Re-Collection includes:

 Amnesia: The Bunker
 Amnesia: Rebirth
 Amnesia: The Dark Descent
 Amnesia: A Machine For Pigs

In addition to the games above, The Frictional Collection also includes:

 SOMA
 Penumbra

Grab the Amnesia Re-Collection bundle for an additional 15% discount on all Amnesia games, or the Frictional Collection for 20% discount on all games!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20170/Amnesia_Recollection/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6817/Frictional_Collection/

notes.title: SOMA dev's horror follow-up Amnesia: Rebirth gets October release date, new trailer
notes.notes: SOMA developer Frictional Games' latest delve into the depths of horror, Amnesia: Rebirth, will be making its way to PC and PS4 just in time for Halloween, launching on 20th October.Amnesia: Rebirth is the follow-up to Frictional's seminal horror effort, Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a game that celebrates its tenth anniversary this year (2013's Amnesia: A Machine for Pigs was developed by Everybody's Gone to the Rapture studio The Chinese Room). It's all change this time though, and Rebirth follows the tribulations of new protagonist Tasi Trianon as she journeys across the Algerian desert pulling together the fragments of her shattered past. There's exploration to be done, puzzles to be solved, and limited mental and physical resources to be managed, with Frictional promising a plunge through a variety of "uncanny environments, from scorched deserts and dark caves to forgotten ruins and alien landscapes."Read more
